asset_set: Questionnaire Q14 option 2 — Designing museum exhibits

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under pedestal and forearms — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle matte plaster suggestion on pedestal via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: curatorial creative energy — approachable exhibit-building craft, not a stiff museum boardroom
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

secondary.name: lavender
secondary.use: diorama base accent, label stand trim

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: yellow appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlights on pedestal edge and spotlight cone
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and pedestal base

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: positions a small diorama figure on the display pedestal
left_hand.grip: delicate pinch on the figure's base
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: adjusts the angle of a small spotlight tool
right_hand.grip: two-finger tilt on the spotlight head

pose.gesture_summary: mid-installation freeze frame — final placement of a display piece
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of forearms carefully installs a small diorama figure onto a clean white display pedestal, while the other hand angles a compact spotlight tool for the perfect highlight. A blank label stand waits beside the scene. The moment reads as thoughtful exhibit craftsmanship — spatial storytelling in miniature, not a dry boardroom task.

primary_objects.name: display pedestal
primary_objects.detail: simple rectangular block with a rounded top edge

primary_objects.name: mini diorama figure
primary_objects.detail: simplified abstract figure shape, no facial detail

primary_objects.name: spotlight tool
primary_objects.detail: small cone-shaped head casting a soft yellow glow

primary_objects.name: label stand
primary_objects.detail: blank rectangular plaque, no readable text

subject.environment: light museum prep table surface strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from figure-placing hand → pedestal → spotlight hand
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: table edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: pedestal silhouette + two hand shapes readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, museum brand, letter A, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, stiff boardroom, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. KursoKo quiz choice for "Designing museum exhibits". Style: flat vector, 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, solid fills, minimal cel shadow under hands — matches KursoKo RIASEC sticker family, NO letter, NO border frame, NO text on image. Scene: two forearms installing a coral #FF8A65 diorama figure onto a light-grey display pedestal. Right hand angles a yellow #FFD54F spotlight tool above it. A blank lavender #9575CD label plaque rests beside the pedestal, no readable text. Loose stone-grey hoodie sleeves pushed to mid-forearm with yellow cuff trim, faint lavender paint smudge on thumb. Warm medium skin tone #C8956C. Three-quarter top-down camera, hands in lower half, transparent margins. Mood: attentive, curatorial craftsmanship.
